discovery: Precision mapping of the cosmic microwave background anisotropies with WMAP, establishing the standard ΛCDM cosmological model

nominees.name: David N. Spergel
nominees.affiliation: Simons Foundation and Princeton University, USA

motivation: The Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe, conceived and led by Bennett with Page directing instrument design and Spergel leading the theoretical interpretation, turned cosmology into a precision science. Its full-sky, carefully calibrated maps of the CMB temperature and polarization anisotropies measured the age, geometry, matter and baryon content of the universe to percent-level accuracy, confirmed a nearly flat universe with nearly scale-invariant adiabatic primordial fluctuations, detected early reionization, and independently confirmed that dark energy dominates the cosmic energy budget. WMAP established the six-parameter ΛCDM model now used as the reference for all of cosmology, including the predicted expansion rate whose comparison with local measurements has become a sharp test of fundamental physics. This was meticulous, systematics-controlled measurement that redefined our understanding of the universe's contents and origin, and it laid the foundation on which Planck and current CMB experiments were built.
